verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AI automations for payroll prep, such as gathering hours and flagging anomalies, plus invoice ingestion into paysheets, AI-tool and MCP connections, and a cash-flow Money Dashboard. None of it documents AI automation of month-end accounting close, such as syncing journal entries to a ledger, reconciliation, or categorization. Payroll automation is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for a book-close story under the accounting-integrations theme.
